DESCRIPTION:
Start a local HTTP proxy that swaps a proxy token for a real Azure bearer token

USAGE:
    pks foundry proxy [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    pks foundry proxy
    pks foundry proxy --port 8080
    pks foundry proxy --token my-secret

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help     Prints help information                                      
    -p, --port     Port to listen on (default: random free port)                
    -t, --token    Proxy token clients must send in Authorization header        
                   (default: random UUID)                                       
    -s, --scope    Azure token scope (default: cognitive services)
